rulings: use separate forecast-scoped result namespace and full own-parent links instead of modifying legacy race storage/name matching — preserves immutable B/source identity and old clients — cost if wrong is additional storage/API plumbing and temporarily reduced label coverage, not fabricated results.

preserve existing evaluation schema1/UI proof projection after server-side full new-label validation; retain new label nonce/finalization in its own complete API/backups — keeps verified old4 behavior and avoids unrelated UI protocol changes — cost if wrong is that a viewer needs the dedicated label API/backup to inspect its request nonce rather than the score report alone.

canonical UTC microsecond formatting applies to newly authored packet/envelope clocks, while parser-owned record strings and hash remain unchanged and are checked as strict parsed instants — resolves explicit immutable-record requirement against existing parser offset/zero-fraction formatting — cost if wrong is accepting equivalent parser timestamp spellings; no rounding, time substitution, day or ordering relaxation.

an unseen request nonce requires packet/receipt/finalization all absent; even identical content-addressed packet reuse under another nonce rejects, while complete identical same-nonce retry replays — keeps partial/orphan evidence from becoming adopted and prevents duplicate publication — cost if wrong is conservative rejection of a legitimate duplicate/recovery attempt, requiring explicit review rather than silent reuse.

completed identical POST retry also requires a valid same-forecast latest index (possibly a newer nonce); missing/malformed index rejects, with no automatic repair, while a complete marker-backed pinned GET remains readable — treats indexed publication completion separately from immutable finalized recovery evidence — cost if wrong is rejecting an otherwise recoverable retry and requiring explicit recovery rather than silently adopting a partial index state.
scope: Per-task and broad independent static reviews; live evidence independently audited separately. No repeated full branch review.
